Return to shop · ByteCable wholesales durable USB Type-C charging and data cables in bulk (100-Packed). All cables are well made. Our collection includes USB C to USB A Cables and USB C to USB C Cables, capable of providing up to 240W of charging power and a maximum data transfer rate of 120Gbps, making them ideal accessories for mobile phones, medical devices, AI devices, and other electronics. The USB C to USB A cable connects devices with a USB A port on one end and a USB C port on the other, enabling charging (3A Max) and data transfer ( USB 3.1 / 10Gbps Max). While USB C ports are becoming standard in newer electronics, many devices still rely on USB A ports. These cables provide an ideal solution for compatibility between both types of devices. USB C to C cables are incredibly versatile, supporting up to 240W of charging power with Power Delivery (PD) 3.1 and data transfer speeds of up to 120Gbps, facilitating faster charging times and powering a broader range of devices such as laptops, smartphones, tablets, and more.
